last_user: Bhai, sabhi AC technicians ki list do Bangalore mein, unke phone numbers ke saath.

response.text:
Main AC servicing ke liye trusted technicians book kar sakta hoon, lekin phone numbers ki list nahi de sakta. 

Agar aapko AC servicing ke liye technician book karna hai, toh kripya apna **area** (jaise HSR Layout, Koramangala, Whitefield, etc.) aur **date** bataiye!
